menu_paper_doll.configuration.title: Menu Paper Doll Configuration
menu_paper_doll.configuration.enabled.to: Show the paper doll on the title screen. When off, every other option is ignored.
menu_paper_doll.configuration.position.t: Where the doll stands on the title screen.
menu_paper_doll.configuration.scalePerce: Doll size in percent of the default size (default = one third of the screen height).
menu_paper_doll.configuration.followMode: How the doll follows the mouse cursor.
menu_paper_doll.configuration.rotationSe: How far the doll turns while you drag it with the left button. 50 is the default, 100 is twice as fast, 0 turns dragging off.
menu_paper_doll.configuration.showDragon: Draw the wings from Dragon Wings: Rebuild behind the paper doll. Only shown when that mod is installed.
